sentences.text: Counsel for Applicant :- Rajendra Singh Parihar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material on record.

The present application u/s 483 Cr.P.C. has been moved with prayer to direct the learned court of C.M.M., Kanpur Nagar to decide the Case No.241328 of 2022 (State of U.P. vs. Firoj Khan and others) arising out of Case Crime No.858 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 354, 506, 406 I.P.C. &
3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Chakeri, District Kanpur Nagar, pending before him within specific period as fixed by this Hon'ble Court.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that a Case No.241328 of 2022 is pending before the learned court of C.M.M., Kanpur Nagar since 2022 but till now appearance of the accused Firoja Khatoon vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45927430/

entities.text: State of U.P. vs. Firoj Khan and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: could not be ensured by the learned court concerned, therefore, prays that a direction be issued to the learned court concerned to decide the same as expeditiously as possible.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of record as well as the order sheet, it appears that the appearance of the accused persons could not be ensured by the learned court concerned till now.

In such circumstances, it is expedient to direct the learned court concerned to take stern steps against the accused persons for ensuring their appearance and to make its endeavour to proceed with the aforesaid case as expeditiously as possible without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties, in accordance with law, if there is no legal impediment.
Accordingly, this application is disposed of finally with the above directions.

Order Date :- 15.3.2024 Ashok Gupta  Firoja Khatoon vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45927430/
